name: AI-Skill-Library
purpose: Portable, provenance-first inventory and governance scaffold for AI agent skills.
not_done: GitHub Actions results for the latest proposal commit, including zizmor audit findings.
Host-specific CLI discovery, activation, invocation and evaluation tests have not been run.
No project-wide license has been selected for original repository material.
No comprehensive skill-level static and dynamic security assessment has been completed.
No matched baseline-versus-skill evaluation report exists across the five skills and five hosts.
No versioned release package, SBOM, build provenance attestation or signature-verification procedure has been published.
principles: Do not redistribute proprietary/plugin-hosted skill bodies without rights.
Pin source commits and record Git object identifiers for published files.
Review each license at file/subtree level.
Scan and manually inspect before execution.
Measure skill lift against a matched baseline.
Use host adapters rather than forking canonical content.
Distinguish format validation from host runtime compatibility and task evaluation.
Do not declare commercial readiness while a release gate remains blocked.
